title: Superhuman assistant section
description: A product section on the light page: centred lockup, two-tone headline, lead and buttons, then a bento of three colour tiles (one wide teal tile and two half-width tiles, maroon and stone) with media slots, then a five-tab strip with icons (active tab underlined, hover tint) over three soft cards that change with the tab. On phones the tiles and cards stack and the tab strip scrolls sideways.
notes: deep tiles use chart-1/2 with light text; best on the Superhuman theme
each tab holds its own cards; the first tab is shown in static HTML
